I'm an independent data and AI consultant based in Fruita, Colorado. I founded Dynamodal in 2022, and I work as a subcontractor with consulting teams that need an experienced, hands-on data person.

I studied physics and electrical engineering at the Colorado School of Mines, then spent several years in Alaska's oil fields before moving into data science consulting. Before Dynamodal, I was on the data analytics and modeling team at a national consulting firm, delivering scenario modeling and analysis for utility and government clients on everything from grid modernization to energy efficiency evaluation.

I've worked with data for about two decades and with R for nearly as long. Along the way I've done a lot of IT work too, and that's where I'm most useful: between the people who want to do ambitious analysis and the systems, policies, and tools that have to support it.

These days my work centers on three things: helping teams adopt AI tools and coding agents with clear eyes about the risks, designing data models and platforms that hold up, and making teams more efficient through better documentation, workflows, and habits.

When I'm not working, I'm usually on a bike, running, or out on the trails and rivers around Fruita. I also run [Fruita Tech Wizard](https://fruitatechwizard.com), a small side project helping neighbors with their everyday tech.
